remediation.qaStatement: The R0.3 COMPOSED coverage surface is not the complete governed effective Road LTL 1.5 module surface. The implementation composes data/modules/road-ltl-v1.4.json with the v1.4/v1.5 Operational Knowledge payloads, but omits the governed data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json module overlay from semantic composition. R0.2 already certified effective Road LTL 1.5 as the lossless materialization of the v1.4 module base plus the v1.5 module overlay, with 21 inherited tasks and LTL-03 as the single direct module override.
remediation.accepted: QA is correct. The superseded candidate composed data/modules/road-ltl-v1.4.json with the v1.4/v1.5 Operational Knowledge payloads and omitted data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json from the semantic surface, while listing it as a governed input. LTL-03 was therefore measured against v1.4 module semantics and simultaneously classified DIRECT_GOVERNED_1_5_OVERRIDE.

findings.statement: R0.3-QA-01 is remediated. The composed surface is now the R0.2-certified effective Road LTL 1.5 module materialization plus the Operational Knowledge payload and its governed 1.5 overlay. LTL-03 absent attributes fall from 8 to 5; composed satisfied cells move from 290 to 291 of 528.

R0.3-QA-02 is NOT remediated and remains BLOCKING for completion. Drive candidate custody could not be created; the connector returned 'No approval received' on two attempts. This requires an operator or a Drive write approval; the implementation agent cannot clear it.

Five new declared equivalences read from the governed v1.5 operationalKnowledgeV2 and executionReadiness containers. Today they apply to LTL-03 only, because it is the only task the governed v1.5 module overlay enriches. QA should review them alongside the original equivalence set.

prohibitedWhen is now satisfied for 1 of 22 tasks rather than 0. jurisdictionIds, carriageRegimeIds, conditionIds, ambiguities and unresolvedDependencies remain absent for all 22, including LTL-03. The governed v1.5 enrichment did not supply them and none were invented.

REGISTRY/CUSTODY SYNCHRONIZATION STILL OUTSTANDING, carried forward from R0.3-B-06. The Drive recovery-standard and backlog mirrors still read 'Current authorized stage: R0.1C'. R0.3 did not edit them; governance synchronization is not in this stage's authorized scope, which is R0.3_REMEDIATION_ONLY.

Gap findings are unchanged by remediation: 66 canonical objects with 0 object contracts, 76 BOL fields with 0 conformant Information Resolution records, 24 knowledge gaps all OPEN. The remediation corrected a measurement surface; it did not author semantics.

The post-QA governance state, including the QA-authored Checkpoint C and the updated queue, was merged into this branch before remediation so the stage builds on the governed state rather than a stale baseline. Checkpoint C was not authored or modified by this agent.
All 14 Checkpoint A inputs remain byte-identical. No frozen source asset was mutated, no pointer or register was touched, and the queue was not edited.
